Indicates whether the action succeeded (2xx status codes) or failed (4xx client errors, 5xx server errors). Used to track both successful operations and failed attempts for security monitoring and compliance reporting.
response_status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_super_admin_audit_logs.response_status. Integer HTTP response status code (2xx for success, 4xx/5xx for failures).

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the audit log entry was created.

Automatically set when the super administrator action is performed. Used for chronological ordering of audit events and time-based filtering in audit reports. Stored in UTC with timezone information.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_super_admin_audit_logs.created_at. DateTime with timestamptz format. Automatically set when the action is performed.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the audit log entry was last updated.

For audit logs, this field equals created_at since records are immutable and never modified after creation. Included for schema consistency with temporal field requirements across all entities.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_super_admin_audit_logs.updated_at. DateTime with timestamptz format. For audit logs, equals created_at as records are immutable.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the audit log entry was soft deleted.

Nullable field supporting soft delete capability for compliance-driven data retention policies. Audit logs should rarely be deleted due to their critical role in security compliance and forensic analysis. Non-null value indicates the record has been soft deleted.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_super_admin_audit_logs.deleted_at. Nullable DateTime with timestamptz format. Supports soft delete for compliance-driven data retention policies, though audit logs should rarely be deleted.

IShoppingMallSuperAdminAuditLog.description:
Complete super administrator audit log record containing all action details and metadata for security compliance and forensic analysis.

This type represents an immutable audit trail entry capturing every administrative action performed by super administrators. Each record includes the action type, target entity information, request metadata, client details (IP address, user agent), and timestamps.

The superAdmin property provides context about which administrator performed the action. The target_id and request_body fields are nullable as some actions may not target specific records or may not include request payloads.
IShoppingMallSuperAdminAuditLog.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_super_admin_audit_logs table. All fields included: id, action_type, target_model, target_id (nullable), ip_address, user_agent, request_body (nullable JSON string), response_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at (nullable). Relation: superAdmin via JOIN to shopping_mall_super_admins on super_admin_id FK, returned as IShoppingMallSuperAdmin.ISummary reference. Immutable audit trail - records are append-only.

name.description:
The human-readable name for the category displayed to customers when browsing the catalog.

This field is mandatory and must be unique across all categories in the system. Examples include 'Electronics', 'Clothing', 'Books' for top-level categories, or 'Smartphones', 'Men's Shirts' for subcategories. The uniqueness constraint prevents ambiguity in category identification.
name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_categories.name. Must be unique across all categories (validated before insert).

description.description:
Optional detailed text explaining what types of products belong in this category.

This field provides additional context about the category's contents and is displayed on category pages to help customers understand the category scope. It can be null for simple categories where the name is self-explanatory. When provided, it should clearly describe the range of products that fall under this category.
description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_categories.description. Nullable field - can be null for simple categories where the name is self-explanatory.

parentId.description:
References the parent category for hierarchical organization when creating a subcategory.

This field is optional. When null or omitted, the category is created as a top-level category. When provided, it must be a valid UUID referencing an existing top-level category (a category that itself has no parent). The system enforces exactly one level of nesting - you cannot create a subcategory under another subcategory.

Examples: If creating a 'Smartphones' subcategory, set parentId to the UUID of the 'Electronics' top-level category. If creating a new top-level category like 'Sports & Outdoors', leave this field null or omit it.
parentId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_categories.parent_id. Nullable UUID field. When provided, must reference an existing top-level category (one with no parent). System enforces one-level nesting: subcategories cannot have their own children.

IShoppingMallCategory.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new product category in the catalog.

This DTO contains the data required to create a new category. The category name is mandatory and must be unique across all categories. The description is optional and provides additional context about the category's contents. The parentId field is optional and is used when creating a subcategory under an existing top-level category, enabling exactly one level of nesting.

Only administrators can use this DTO via the POST /shoppingMall/admin/categories endpoint. The system validates that the name is unique and that parentId (if provided) references an existing top-level category.
IShoppingMallCategory.ICreate.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_categories table. User-provided fields: name, description, parent_id. Excluded: id (auto-generated UUID), created_at/updated_at (system timestamps set on insert), deleted_at (soft delete marker, null on creation), parent relation (FK column parent_id is the user input, not the joined object), children/products/productSnapshots (has-many relations, not created via this DTO).

status.description: Decision on the promotion request.

rejection_note.description: Explanation for rejection when status is 'rejected'.

IShoppingMallAdminPromotionRequest.IUpda.description:
Update request for reviewing an administrator promotion request.

Used by super administrators to approve or reject administrator promotion requests submitted by members or sellers. The status field determines the decision outcome, and rejection_note provides feedback when rejecting.

The {@link status} must be either 'approved' or 'rejected'. When status is 'rejected', the {@link rejection_note} should explain the decision to help the applicant understand why their request was denied.
IShoppingMallAdminPromotionRequest.IUpda.x-autobe-specification: Maps to shopping_mall_admin_promotion_requests table. Update fields: status (pending→approved/rejected), rejection_note (when rejected). Excluded: id (path param), actor_type/reason (immutable), reviewed_by_super_admin_id (from JWT), timestamps (auto). Service layer validates: status must change from pending, rejection_note required when status='rejected'.

sellerProfileId.description:
Filter snapshots by a specific seller profile.

When provided, restricts query results to only snapshots belonging to the specified seller profile. This is useful for viewing the complete edit history of a single seller's profile or tracking changes made by a specific seller over time.

The value must be a valid UUID matching the seller profile's unique identifier. Omit this field to retrieve snapshots across all sellers (administrators only).
sellerProfileId.x-autobe-specification: Filters shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots by shopping_mall_seller_profile_id column. When provided, adds WHERE shopping_mall_seller_profile_id = {sellerProfileId} clause. Uses composite index on (shopping_mall_seller_profile_id, created_at) for efficient filtering. UUID format validation required.

createdAtFrom.description:
Filter snapshots created on or after this timestamp.

Defines the lower bound of the creation date range for filtering snapshots. Only snapshots created at or after this timestamp will be included in the results.

The value must be in ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., '2024-01-15T00:00:00Z'). Combine with createdAtTo to query snapshots within a specific time period. Omit to include all snapshots from the beginning of time.
createdAtFrom.x-autobe-specification: Filters shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots by created_at column with >= operator. Adds WHERE created_at >= {createdAtFrom} clause when provided. ISO 8601 date-time format required. Use for chronological range queries to find snapshots created on or after a specific timestamp.

createdAtTo.description:
Filter snapshots created on or before this timestamp.

Defines the upper bound of the creation date range for filtering snapshots. Only snapshots created at or before this timestamp will be included in the results.

The value must be in ISO 8601 date-time format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z'). Combine with createdAtFrom to query snapshots within a specific time period. Omit to include all snapshots up to the present moment.
createdAtTo.x-autobe-specification: Filters shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots by created_at column with <= operator. Adds WHERE created_at <= {createdAtTo} clause when provided. ISO 8601 date-time format required. Use with createdAtFrom for bounded chronological range queries.

page.description:
Page number for paginated results.

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1, so page 1 returns the first set of results, page 2 returns the second set, and so on.

The actual offset is calculated as (page - 1) * limit. For example, with limit=10, page 1 returns records 1-10, page 2 returns records 11-20. Minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1 when not provided.
page.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control parameter. Calculates OFFSET as (page - 1) * limit for database query. 1-indexed (page 1 = first page). Minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1 when not provided. Used with limit to implement cursor-based or offset pagination.

limit.description:
Maximum number of records per page.

Controls how many snapshot records are returned in a single page of results. This allows clients to balance between response size and number of requests needed to browse all results.

The value must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Larger limits reduce the number of API calls needed but increase response payload size. When not provided, defaults to a system-configured value. The actual number of records returned may be less than the limit on the final page.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Pagination control parameter. Sets LIMIT clause for database query. Minimum value is 1, maximum is 100. Defaults to a system default (typically 20 or 50) when not provided. Works with page to control result set size per request.

IShoppingMallSellerProfileSnapshot.IRequ.description:
Search criteria for filtering and paginating seller profile snapshot queries.

This request DTO provides optional filtering capabilities for browsing the immutable history of seller profile changes. All fields are optional and can be combined or used independently to narrow down snapshot results.

The sellerProfileId field restricts results to snapshots of a specific seller's profile. The createdAtFrom and createdAtTo fields enable chronological range queries to find snapshots within a specific time period. Pagination is controlled through page and limit parameters, with results ordered by creation timestamp in descending order by default (most recent first).
IShoppingMallSellerProfileSnapshot.IRequ.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for querying seller profile snapshots. Properties are filter and pagination parameters, not direct table mappings. sellerProfileId filters by shopping_mall_seller_profile_id column using WHERE clause. createdAtFrom/createdAtTo filter created_at timestamp column with >= and <= operators. page/limit control OFFSET/LIMIT pagination. Query uses composite index on (shopping_mall_seller_profile_id, created_at) for efficient filtering. Default ordering is created_at DESC.

reason.description:
Applicant's reason for requesting administrator privileges.

Text explanation provided by the member or seller explaining why they want to become an administrator. This helps super administrators evaluate the request.

The reason should describe the applicant's qualifications, experience, or motivation for seeking administrator role. This field is required and must not be empty.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_admin_promotion_requests.reason. User-provided text explaining why applicant wants administrator privileges. Validation: must not be empty string.

IShoppingMallAdminPromotionRequest.ICrea.description:
Request body for submitting an administrator promotion request.

Contains the applicant's reason for requesting administrator privileges. The system automatically determines the applicant type (member or seller) from the authenticated user's account and sets the initial status to 'pending'.

This DTO is used when a member or seller wants to request promotion to administrator status. The reason field should explain why the applicant believes they are qualified for the administrator role.
IShoppingMallAdminPromotionRequest.ICrea.x-autobe-specification: Create DTO for admin promotion requests. Maps only the reason field from user input. All other fields are auto-generated or resolved from JWT: actor_type determined from authenticated user role (member/seller), status auto-set to 'pending', reviewed_by_super_admin_id null initially, rejection_note null initially, timestamps auto-generated. Subtype records created in shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_members or shopping_mall_admin_promotion_request_of_sellers based on actor_type.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the seller approval request.

This is the primary key of the approval request record, generated as a UUID when the request is created. Used to reference this specific approval request in API operations and database queries.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.id. UUID format generated by database.

seller.description:
The seller who submitted this approval request.

References the seller account that initiated this registration application. Contains the seller's email, current approval status, and account timestamps. Used to identify the applicant and display their information during the approval review process.
seller.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via seller_id FK to shopping_mall_sellers.id. Returns ISeller.ISummary with seller's email, approvalStatus, and timestamps. JOIN required.

reviewedByAdmin.description:
The administrator who reviewed and made a decision on this approval request.

Populated only after an administrator has reviewed the request and made an approval or rejection decision. Null when the request status is 'pending' and awaiting review. Contains the reviewing administrator's email, grade level, and account status.
reviewedByAdmin.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via reviewed_by_admin_id FK to shopping_mall_admins.id. Returns IAdmin.ISummary when populated, null when request is pending. LEFT JOIN required. Only set after administrator reviews the request.

status.description:
Current workflow status of the seller approval request.

Indicates the current state of the approval request in the review workflow. Valid values are 'pending' (awaiting administrator review), 'approved' (seller has been granted selling permissions), or 'rejected' (application denied by administrator).

Only pending requests can be updated. Once approved or rejected, the status is final. Sellers can submit a new request if their application was rejected.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.status. Enum values: 'pending' (awaiting review), 'approved' (seller can sell), 'rejected' (application denied). Status transitions: pending → approved or pending → rejected.

rejectionReason.description:
Administrator-provided reason for rejecting the seller application.

Populated only when the request status is 'rejected'. Contains the administrator's explanation for why the seller's application was denied, allowing the seller to understand what issues need to be addressed in a re-application.

Null for pending and approved requests. This field provides transparency in the approval process and helps sellers improve their applications.
rejectionReason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.rejection_reason. String when status is 'rejected', null otherwise. Populated by administrator when rejecting the request.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the seller approval request was created.

Records the exact date and time when the seller submitted their registration application. This timestamp is set once during creation and remains immutable throughout the request's lifecycle.

Used for tracking how long requests have been pending, sorting requests by submission date, and audit purposes.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.created_at. DateTime with timestamptz format. Set once when the approval request is created, never modified.

updatedAt.description:
Timestamp when the seller approval request was last modified.

Updated whenever the approval request record is modified, most notably when an administrator reviews the request and changes its status from 'pending' to 'approved' or 'rejected'. Also updated on any other modifications to the request record.

Used for tracking request activity and detecting concurrent modifications during updates.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.updated_at. DateTime with timestamptz format. Updated whenever the request is modified, particularly when status changes from pending to approved/rejected.

deletedAt.description:
Timestamp when the seller approval request was soft deleted.

Null for active approval request records. Populated with the deletion timestamp when the record is soft deleted, marking it as inactive while preserving it for audit and historical purposes.

Soft-deleted records are excluded from normal queries and API responses. This supports data retention policies and audit trail requirements.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests.deleted_at. DateTime with timestamptz format, nullable. Null for active records, populated when soft deleted.

IShoppingMallSellerApprovalRequest.description:
Seller approval request entity representing a seller's registration application and its workflow status.

This type represents the complete approval request record including the current workflow status (pending, approved, or rejected), rejection reason if applicable, and audit timestamps. Sellers can access their own approval requests to check approval status. Administrators can access all approval requests to review pending submissions and make approval decisions.

The seller property references the seller who submitted the request. The reviewedByAdmin property is populated only after an administrator has reviewed the request (null when pending). The rejectionReason is only present when status is 'rejected', providing feedback to the seller.
IShoppingMallSellerApprovalRequest.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_approval_requests table. Columns: id, status, rejection_reason, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: seller via JOIN to shopping_mall_sellers on seller_id, reviewedByAdmin via LEFT JOIN to shopping_mall_admins on reviewed_by_admin_id (nullable). FK columns seller_id and reviewed_by_admin_id are transformed to relation objects in the DTO.

id.description:
Unique identifier of the seller profile snapshot.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the snapshot is created. Used to retrieve this specific snapshot record via API endpoints.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.id. UUID format primary key.

sellerProfile.description:
Reference to the seller profile that this snapshot belongs to.

Links the historical snapshot back to the current seller profile entity. The returned summary includes the seller's current shop information, not the historical state (which is captured in the snapshot's shop_name, shop_description, and logo_image_url fields).
sellerProfile.x-autobe-specification: Join from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.shopping_mall_seller_profile_id to shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id. Returns IShoppingMallSellerProfile.ISummary with current seller profile information.

shop_name.description:
The seller's shop name at the time this snapshot was created.

This is the historical value that was visible to customers when the snapshot was taken. It may differ from the current shop name if the seller has edited their profile since this snapshot was created.
shop_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.shop_name. Denormalized value preserved at snapshot creation time.

shop_description.description:
The seller's shop description at the time this snapshot was created.

This is the historical description that was visible to customers when the snapshot was taken. It may differ from the current description if the seller has edited their profile since this snapshot was created.
shop_description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.shop_description. Denormalized value preserved at snapshot creation time.

logo_image_url.description:
The seller's logo image URL at the time this snapshot was created.

This is the historical logo URL that was visible to customers when the snapshot was taken. May be null if the seller had not uploaded a logo at the time of snapshot creation. The URL points to the stored image file.
logo_image_url.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.logo_image_url. Nullable - preserves null if no logo existed at snapshot time. URL format validated.

created_at.description:
The timestamp when this seller profile snapshot was created.

Automatically set when the snapshot is generated, which occurs whenever a seller edits their profile (shop name, description, or logo). Used to establish chronological order of profile changes and to determine which snapshot was active at the time of a purchase.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots.created_at. Timestamp with timezone (timestamptz). Records exact moment of snapshot creation.

IShoppingMallSellerProfileSnapshot.description:
Immutable snapshot of a seller profile capturing the shop name, description, and logo at a specific point in time.

Seller profile snapshots are automatically created whenever a seller edits their profile information. Each snapshot preserves the exact state that was visible to customers at that moment, enabling accurate order history verification and dispute resolution.

The snapshot includes a reference to the seller profile along with all profile fields as they existed when the snapshot was created. The logo_image_url may be null if no logo was uploaded at the time of snapshot creation.
IShoppingMallSellerProfileSnapshot.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profile_snapshots table. Query by primary key id (UUID). Join sellerProfile via shopping_mall_seller_profile_id FK to shopping_mall_seller_profiles table, returning IShoppingMallSellerProfile.ISummary. All fields are immutable historical values captured at snapshot creation time. No computed fields.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the member account.

This is the primary key of the member account, automatically generated as a UUID upon registration. Used to reference the member across all platform operations including orders, reviews, and profile management.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.id. UUID format generated by database.

email.description:
Email address used for authentication and communication.

This field serves as the primary login credential alongside password. Must be unique across all member accounts. Used for password reset emails, order confirmations, and platform notifications. Email verification is required before full account activation.
email.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.email. Unique constraint enforced at database level. Used as login credential.

status.description:
Account status controlling access permissions.

Three states: 'active' for normal operation with full platform access, 'banned' for administrator-imposed restrictions preventing login while preserving order history, and 'deleted' for user-requested account deletion with soft-delete preserving orders and reviews for legal compliance.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.status. String enum values: active, banned, deleted. Controls account access permissions.

profile.description:
Customer profile information linked to the member account.

Contains customer-specific profile data including display name and phone number. Present when the member has registered as a customer. Null for members who are only sellers or administrators without customer profile. The display name is shown throughout the platform in order confirmations and reviews.
profile.x-autobe-specification: Computed via LEFT JOIN shopping_mall_customer_profiles on shopping_mall_member_id. Returns IShoppingMallCustomerProfile when member has customer profile, null otherwise. One-to-one relationship derived from shopping_mall_members.customerProfile relation.

administrator.description:
Administrator role information if the member has been promoted.

Present when the member has been approved as an administrator through the admin promotion request workflow. Contains administrator grade level (regular or super) determining permission scope. Null for regular members without administrator privileges.
administrator.x-autobe-specification: Computed via LEFT JOIN shopping_mall_administrators on shopping_mall_member_id. Returns IShoppingMallAdministrator.ISummary when member is promoted to administrator, null otherwise. One-to-one relationship derived from shopping_mall_members.administrator relation.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was created.

Records the exact date and time when the customer registered on the platform. Automatically set by the database upon account creation and never modified. Used for account age verification and audit purposes.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.created_at. Auto-generated by database on INSERT. Immutable after creation.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was last modified.

Updated on any account change including status updates, password changes, and profile modifications. Automatically managed by the database. Used for tracking account activity and audit trails.
updated_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.updated_at. Auto-updated by database on any UPDATE to the member record.

deleted_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was soft deleted.

Null when the account is active. Set to the deletion timestamp when the customer requests account deletion or when an administrator bans the account. Soft delete preserves order history and reviews for legal compliance and seller records while preventing login access.
deleted_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members.deleted_at. Nullable - null when account is active, datetime when soft-deleted. Set on account deletion or admin ban.

IShoppingMallMember.description:
Complete member account record including authentication credentials metadata, account status, and lifecycle timestamps.

This DTO represents a registered user account on the shopping mall platform. Members can be customers, sellers, or administrators depending on their roles and approval status. The account status controls access permissions: active members can use all features, banned members cannot log in (administrator action), and deleted members have soft-deleted accounts.

The profile relation contains customer-specific information (display name, phone number) when the member has a customer profile. The administrator relation is present when the member has been promoted to an administrator role.
IShoppingMallMember.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members table: id, email, status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Excludes password_hash for security. Profile computed via LEFT JOIN shopping_mall_customer_profiles on shopping_mall_member_id (returns IShoppingMallCustomerProfile or null). Administrator computed via LEFT JOIN shopping_mall_administrators on shopping_mall_member_id (returns IShoppingMallAdministrator.ISummary or null). For admin endpoints, include soft-deleted members (deleted_at IS NOT NULL). For customer endpoints, filter out soft-deleted members.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the administrator account.

Primary key of the administrator record. Used to reference this administrator in other API operations and audit logs.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.id. UUID format generated by database.

grade.description:
Administrator grade level determining permission scope.

Two grade levels exist: 'regular' for standard administrators who can manage seller approvals, categories, products, orders, and users; and 'super' for super administrators who have elevated privileges including promoting/demoting other administrators and approving admin promotion requests.
grade.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.grade. Values: 'regular' or 'super'.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when this administrator profile was created.

Records when the administrator account was established through the admin promotion request workflow. Used for audit trails and sorting administrator lists by creation date.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format.

member.description:
The base member account that this administrator profile extends.

Each administrator is linked to exactly one member account for authentication. This relation provides access to the underlying member's profile information including display name, email, and contact details. The member account handles login credentials while the administrator profile stores grade-level permissions.
member.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via shopping_mall_member_id FK to shopping_mall_members.id. Returns IShoppingMallMember.ISummary with member profile information.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an administrator account for list views and administrative oversight.

Contains essential identification and profile information including administrator grade level, account creation timestamp, and linked member profile. Used in paginated administrator listings accessed by admin and superAdmin actors.

The grade field distinguishes between regular administrators and super administrators. The member reference provides access to the underlying member account profile information including display name and contact details.
IShoppingMallAdministrator.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators table. Properties: id, grade, created_at are direct column mappings. Member relation is joined via shopping_mall_member_id FK to shopping_mall_members table, returning IShoppingMallMember.ISummary. Updated_at and deleted_at are excluded as they are internal audit fields not needed for summary display. The shopping_mall_member_id FK column is excluded because the member relation is exposed as a nested object instead of raw FK.

search.description:
Text search query for finding administrators by email or profile name.

When provided, filters results to administrators whose email address or profile display name contains the search text. Case-insensitive substring matching is applied across both fields.

Omit or pass empty string to disable search filtering and return all administrators matching other criteria.
search.x-autobe-specification: Text search parameter applied as LIKE query across shopping_mall_members.email and member profile display name fields. Case-insensitive substring matching. Null or empty string means no search filter applied.

grade.description:
Filter administrators by their grade level.

Two grade levels exist: 'regular' for standard administrators with platform management permissions, and 'super' for super administrators with elevated privileges including admin promotion/demotion capabilities.

Omit or pass null to return administrators of all grade levels without filtering.
grade.x-autobe-specification: Filter on shopping_mall_administrators.grade column. Values: 'regular' for standard administrators, 'super' for super administrators. Null means no grade filter - returns all grades.

status.description:
Filter administrators by their account status.

Three statuses are tracked: 'active' for accounts that can log in normally, 'banned' for accounts suspended by administrators (cannot log in but data preserved), and 'deleted' for soft-deleted accounts (admin profile removed, base member account remains).

Omit or pass null to return administrators of all statuses without filtering.
status.x-autobe-specification: Computed status filter derived from shopping_mall_administrators.deleted_at and shopping_mall_admins.banned_at. 'active' = deleted_at IS NULL AND banned_at IS NULL. 'banned' = banned_at IS NOT NULL. 'deleted' = deleted_at IS NOT NULL. Null means no status filter.

created_at_from.description:
Filter administrators created on or after this timestamp.

Returns only administrators whose account creation timestamp is greater than or equal to the provided date-time value. Useful for finding recently registered administrators or filtering by date ranges.

Omit or pass null to disable the lower bound filter and include administrators from any creation date.
created_at_from.x-autobe-specification: Filter lower bound for shopping_mall_administrators.created_at. Applied as created_at >= provided timestamp. ISO 8601 date-time format. Null means no lower bound filter.

created_at_to.description:
Filter administrators created on or before this timestamp.

Returns only administrators whose account creation timestamp is less than or equal to the provided date-time value. Useful for finding administrators registered before a specific date or filtering by date ranges.

Omit or pass null to disable the upper bound filter and include administrators from any creation date.
created_at_to.x-autobe-specification: Filter upper bound for shopping_mall_administrators.created_at. Applied as created_at <= provided timestamp. ISO 8601 date-time format. Null means no upper bound filter.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Complete product entity representing a seller's product listing with all details.

Includes product identification (id, name, description), pricing (base_price), ownership (seller), categorization (category), visual assets (images), and purchasable options (variants). Images are ordered by display_order with the first image serving as the main thumbnail. Variants include SKU codes, option value combinations, optional price overrides, and real-time stock availability calculated from the inventory records ledger.

Used for product detail pages accessible to guests, members, sellers, and administrators. Soft-deleted products (deleted_at is set) return 404 Not Found.

IShoppingMallProductImage.ICreate.description:
Request payload for uploading a new product image to a product's gallery.

Contains the image URL pointing to the uploaded image file in object storage or CDN, and the display order position that determines where the image appears in the product gallery. Lower display_order values appear first, with 0 being the main thumbnail.

The product ID is provided in the URL path parameter, not in the request body. The authenticated seller must own the product to upload images. System auto-generates the image ID and manages timestamps.

This UUID serves as the primary key for the promotion request record. It is auto-generated upon request submission and remains immutable throughout the request lifecycle.

This field distinguishes between member and seller applicants. Valid values are 'member' for registered customers or 'seller' for approved sellers. Current status of the promotion request in the approval workflow.

The status tracks the request through the review process. Valid values are:

- **pending**: Request submitted and awaiting super administrator review
- **approved**: Request approved, applicant promoted to regular administrator
- **rejected**: Request denied by super administrator

Status can only transition from 'pending' to either 'approved' or 'rejected'. Once a decision is made, the status cannot be changed.

max_price.description:
Maximum price filter (inclusive).

Returns only variants with a price less than or equal to the specified value. Used to filter out variants above a certain price point.

max_price.x-autobe-specification: Translates to SQL: WHERE price <= max_price. Filters variants where the price column is less than or equal to the specified value. Null prices (using product base_price) require special handling in implementation.

in_stock.description:

When true, returns only variants with positive stock quantity. When false, returns only variants that are out of stock (zero or negative quantity).

- true: Returns only soft-deleted variants (deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
- false: Returns only active variants (deleted_at IS NULL)
- null or omitted: Returns all variants regardless of deletion status

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating product variant listings.

This type defines the search criteria, filters, and pagination parameters used when listing product variants for a specific product. All properties are optional - omitting a property means no filter is applied for that criterion.

Use search for general text matching across SKU code and option values, or use specific filters like sku_code, option_values, and price range filters for precise queries. The in_stock filter calculates current stock from inventory records. Use deleted_at to include or exclude soft-deleted variants.

Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/variants and PATCH /shoppingMall/admin/products/{productId}/variants endpoints.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.description:
Complete product snapshot record preserving the product state at a specific point in time when an edit occurred.

Product snapshots are immutable audit records automatically created whenever a product is modified. Each snapshot captures the denormalized product fields including name, description, category assignment, and base price, enabling historical tracking and dispute resolution. The snapshot includes references to nested variant snapshots that preserve variant configurations at the time of edit.

Sellers can access snapshots for their own products only, while administrators can view any snapshot on the platform for oversight purposes. The {@link id} uniquely identifies each snapshot record, while {@link product} and {@link category} provide context about the snapshotted entity and its classification.

Relations: product via shopping_mall_product_id FK (JOIN to shopping_mall_products), category via shopping_mall_category_id FK (JOIN to shopping_mall_categories). Compositions: productVariantSnapshots (HAS-MANY, nested in shopping_mall_product_variant_snapshots), images (HAS-MANY, nested in shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images). All fields required as snapshots are complete immutable records.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the administrator account.

Primary key of the administrator record in UUID format. This identifier is used to reference the administrator in API operations and is immutable once created.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.id column. UUID format string generated by database.

member.description:
The base member account associated with this administrator.

References the underlying customer member account that provides authentication credentials for this administrator. Each administrator extends exactly one member account, establishing a 1:1 relationship. The member account handles login credentials while the administrator profile stores grade-level permissions.

grade.description:
Administrator grade level determining permission scope.

Two grade levels exist: 'regular' for standard administrators who can manage seller approvals, categories, products, orders, and users; and 'super' for super administrators who have elevated privileges including promoting/demoting other administrators and approving admin promotion requests.

Grade changes are performed exclusively by super administrators through the update endpoint. When an administrator is demoted from super to regular, their administrator profile is soft deleted.
grade.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.grade column. String type constrained to 'regular' or 'super' values at application layer. Controls permission scope within the platform.

createdAt.description:
Timestamp when the administrator profile was created.

Records the exact date and time when this administrator account was established, typically after a super administrator approved an admin promotion request. This timestamp is immutable and system-managed.
createdAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.created_at column. Auto-populated by database on record creation. ISO-8601 date-time format.

updatedAt.description:
Timestamp when the administrator profile was last modified.

Updated automatically whenever the administrator record is changed, including grade modifications, status updates, or other attribute changes. This timestamp helps track the most recent activity on the administrator account.
updatedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.updated_at column. Auto-updated by database on any record modification. ISO-8601 date-time format.

deletedAt.description:
Timestamp when the administrator profile was soft deleted, or null if active.

This field indicates the soft deletion status of the administrator account. When null, the administrator is active and can access the platform. When set to a timestamp, the administrator has been demoted or banned - their administrator profile is logically deleted while preserving the base member account and audit trails.

Soft deletion is used instead of hard deletion to maintain referential integrity with audit logs and to allow potential restoration if needed.
deletedAt.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_administrators.deleted_at column. Nullable - null for active administrators, contains timestamp when soft-deleted (demoted or banned). ISO-8601 date-time format.

IShoppingMallAdministrator.description:
Complete administrator profile including grade level, associated member account, and status timestamps.

Represents an administrator account on the shopping mall platform. Each administrator extends a base member account with elevated permissions. The grade field distinguishes between regular administrators (can manage seller approvals, categories, products, orders, and users) and super administrators (can also promote/demote other administrators and approve admin promotion requests).

The member property references the underlying member account that handles authentication credentials. System-managed timestamps track account lifecycle: createdAt records when the administrator profile was created, updatedAt tracks the last modification, and deletedAt indicates soft deletion status (null for active administrators, timestamp when demoted or banned).

All timestamps in ISO-8601 date-time format. deletedAt is nullable (null for active, timestamp for soft-deleted administrators). Grade accepts only 'regular' or 'super' enum values.

sku_code.description:
Stock Keeping Unit code uniquely identifying this variant within its product.

The SKU code serves as a unique identifier for this specific variant configuration within the parent product. It must be unique among all variants of the same product - attempting to use a duplicate SKU code will result in a conflict error.

This field is used for inventory tracking, order item references, and variant identification in cart and order contexts. Examples include 'RED-L', 'BLUE-M', or any seller-defined coding scheme that uniquely identifies the variant's option combination.

Text representation of the option combination for this variant.

This field provides a human-readable description of the variant's specific option values, such as color, size, material, or other attributes that distinguish it from other variants of the same product.

The format is flexible but should be consistent within a product for better user experience. Examples include 'Color: Red, Size: Large', 'Blue / Small', or '128GB / Black'. This text is displayed to customers in shopping carts, order confirmations, and product listings to help them identify their selected variant.

When provided, this price overrides the parent product's base price for this variant only. This allows sellers to price certain variants differently based on their option values - for example, larger sizes or premium colors may have higher prices.

When null, the product's base price applies to this variant. This is useful when all variants should use the same base price without variant-specific adjustments. The price value should be a positive number representing the amount in the platform's currency.

The entity includes lifecycle timestamps tracking creation, last modification, and soft deletion status. When deletedAt is populated, the category is soft-deleted and should not appear in normal browsing.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.IUpdate.description:
Request payload for product snapshot update operations.

⚠️ Important: This DTO is intentionally empty because product snapshots are immutable audit records. Once a product is edited and a snapshot is created, the snapshot's core fields (name, description, base_price, category assignment, timestamps) cannot be modified.

Image configuration updates are handled through the dedicated child endpoint PATCH /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/snapshots/{snapshotId}/images, which manages the shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images table directly. This parent DTO exists for API framework consistency but contains no updatable properties for the snapshot entity itself.

The immutability principle ensures audit trail integrity for dispute resolution, order item references, and historical verification. Attempting to modify snapshot data contradicts the fundamental design established in business requirements sections 60, 170, and 395.
IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.IUpdate.x-autobe-specification: Update DTO for product snapshot entity - intentionally empty because product snapshots are immutable audit records. No snapshot fields can be modified after creation per business requirements sections 60, 170, 395. Image configuration updates occur through dedicated child endpoint PATCH /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/snapshots/{snapshotId}/images which manages shopping_mall_product_snapshot_images records directly via INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations on the child table. Path parameters (productId, snapshotId) from endpoint URL provide context. All database properties excluded: id and shopping_mall_product_id are path parameters; name, description, base_price, created_at, shopping_mall_category_id are immutable audit data preserved at time of product edit; product and category are immutable belongs-to relations; productVariantSnapshots and images are HAS-MANY composition relations managed through separate child endpoints or are themselves immutable audit data.

When null or omitted, the product's base price applies to this variant. When set, this price overrides the base price for this variant only. Used when certain variants have different pricing due to size, material, or other attributes (e.g., larger sizes cost more, premium materials have higher prices).

Accepts a positive number or null. Cannot be negative or zero.

When provided, overrides the product's base price for this specific variant only. Used when certain variants have different pricing (e.g., larger sizes cost more).

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new product variant.

Contains the variant's SKU code (unique within the product), human-readable option values describing the variant configuration (e.g., 'Color: Red, Size: Large'), optional price override, and optionally the parent product reference.

When price is null or omitted, the product's base price applies to this variant. The SKU code must be unique within the product but can be reused across different products. The shopping_mall_product_id is required when using the general variant creation endpoint (/shoppingMall/seller/variants), but omitted when the product ID is provided via the URL path (/shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/variants).

Fields: sku_code, option_values, price (nullable), shopping_mall_product_id (context-dependent). Excluded: id (UUID v4 auto-generated), created_at/updated_at (server timestamps), deleted_at (soft delete marker, always null on create), product relation (FK column used instead), has-many relations (productVariantSnapshots, inventoryRecords, cartItems, orderItems). For endpoint /shoppingMall/seller/products/{productId}/variants, shopping_mall_product_id is provided via path parameter and omitted from body. For /shoppingMall/seller/variants, shopping_mall_product_id is required in body. Stock quantity starts at zero; inventory managed via separate restock endpoint.

quantity.description:
New quantity for this cart item. Must be at least 1.

This value replaces the existing quantity for the cart item. The system validates that the requested quantity is available in stock before accepting the update.

If you want to remove the item from the cart entirely, use the DELETE endpoint instead of setting quantity to zero.
quantity.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping to shopping_mall_cart_items.quantity column. Backend validates value is positive integer (minimum 1) and does not exceed available stock for the product variant. If quantity exceeds stock, return validation error. The updated_at timestamp is automatically updated by the system.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IUpdate.description:
Update request for modifying a cart item's quantity.

This DTO is used when customers want to change the quantity of a product variant in their shopping cart. The cart item is identified by the path parameter, and only the quantity can be modified.

To change the product variant, customers should remove the existing cart item and add a new one with the desired variant.

All other fields excluded: id identified by path parameter, shopping_mall_cart_id and shopping_mall_product_variant_id are immutable foreign keys, timestamps auto-managed by system, relations not needed in update request. Backend validates quantity is positive integer and does not exceed available stock before updating.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a product snapshot for list views and pagination responses.

Product snapshots are immutable audit records that preserve the complete product state at the time of each edit. This summary type includes essential display fields needed for browsing snapshot history: the product name, base price, category assignment, and creation timestamp.

The category field provides category context for the snapshot, showing which category the product belonged to at the time of the snapshot. Large text fields like description and composition relations like images are excluded to keep the summary lightweight for list views - use the full IShoppingMallProductSnapshot type when complete details are needed.

Snapshots are ordered chronologically with newest first, and the created_at timestamp indicates when the product edit occurred.

Excluded: description (large text field omitted for summary brevity), shopping_mall_product_id (internal FK - product context provided via endpoint path parameter), product relation (not needed in summary view), productVariantSnapshots and images (HAS-MANY composition relations accessed via dedicated endpoints /products/{productId}/snapshots/{snapshotId}/variant-snapshots and /products/{productId}/snapshots/{snapshotId}/images).

The product_variant_id must reference a valid, active product variant. The quantity must be a positive integer with a minimum value of 1. If the same variant already exists in the cart, the new quantity is added to the existing amount rather than creating a duplicate entry, enforced by the unique constraint on cart and product variant.

Backend uses unique constraint on (shopping_mall_cart_id, shopping_mall_product_variant_id) to either INSERT new cart item or UPDATE existing quantity by addition.

Product variant snapshot preserving the complete state of a product variant at the time a product snapshot was created.

search.description:
Partial match search for order code.

Filters orders by performing a case-insensitive partial match against the human-readable order code field. Useful for customers searching their order history by order number or administrators investigating specific orders.

The search term is matched anywhere in the code string. For example, searching '2024' would match orders with codes like 'ORD-2024-001' or '20240101-ABC'.
search.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for partial match search on shopping_mall_orders.code column. Implemented as SQL LIKE '%search%' or equivalent. Case-insensitive search recommended. Empty or omitted search returns all orders.

status.description:
Filter orders by status.

Filters the order list by the current fulfillment status. Can be provided as a single status value or an array of multiple statuses to match.

Order status is computed from constituent order item statuses: 'cancelled' if any item is cancelled, 'refunded' if any item is refunded, 'delivered' if all items are delivered, 'shipped' if any item is shipped, otherwise 'paid'. This computed status determines which orders match the filter.
status.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for filtering orders by status. Accepts single status string or array of status values. Status is computed from child order_items: if any cancelled → 'cancelled', any refunded → 'refunded', all delivered → 'delivered', any shipped → 'shipped', else 'paid'. Filter applied after status computation.

member_id.description:
Filter orders by customer member ID.

Filters the order list to show only orders placed by a specific customer account. This parameter is primarily used in administrative endpoints where staff need to view orders for a particular customer.

For the customer-facing endpoint (/member/orders), this filter is automatically applied based on the authenticated user's identity and should not be provided in the request body.
member_id.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for filtering orders by customer member ID. Direct mapping to shopping_mall_orders.member_id column. Primarily used in admin endpoint to view orders for a specific customer. Member endpoint auto-filters by authenticated user's member_id (not exposed in request body).

seller_id.description:
Filter orders by seller ID.

Filters the order list to show only orders containing items from a specific seller. This parameter is used in administrative oversight and seller dashboard contexts.

The filter requires joining with the order_items table to identify orders that include products from the specified seller. An order may contain items from multiple sellers, so this filter returns orders where at least one item belongs to the specified seller.
seller_id.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for filtering orders by seller ID. Requires JOIN to shopping_mall_order_items to filter orders containing items from a specific seller. Used in admin and seller endpoints. Implemented as EXISTS subquery or JOIN with DISTINCT on order id.

created_at_gte.description:
Filter orders created on or after this timestamp.

Sets the lower bound of the date range filter for order creation timestamps. Orders created at or after this exact timestamp will be included in the results.

Use this parameter to find orders within a specific time period. Combine with created_at_lte to define a complete date range. The timestamp should be provided in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z').
created_at_gte.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for filtering orders created on or after a specific timestamp. Maps to shopping_mall_orders.created_at column with >= comparison. ISO 8601 date-time format required. Used for date range filtering when combined with created_at_lte.

created_at_lte.description:
Filter orders created on or before this timestamp.

Sets the upper bound of the date range filter for order creation timestamps. Orders created at or before this exact timestamp will be included in the results.

Use this parameter to find orders within a specific time period. Combine with created_at_gte to define a complete date range. The timestamp should be provided in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-12-31T23:59:59Z').
created_at_lte.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for filtering orders created on or before a specific timestamp. Maps to shopping_mall_orders.created_at column with <= comparison. ISO 8601 date-time format required. Used for date range filtering when combined with created_at_gte.

page.description:
Page number for pagination (1-indexed).

Specifies which page of results to retrieve. Page numbering starts from 1, so the first page of results is page 1 (not 0).

This parameter works together with limit to control pagination. For example, page=1 with limit=20 returns the first 20 orders, while page=2 with limit=20 returns the next 20 orders. If omitted, defaults to page 1.
page.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for pagination page number. 1-indexed (first page is 1). Defaults to 1 if omitted. Used with limit to implement offset-based pagination. Offset calculated as (page - 1) * limit.

limit.description:
Number of items per page.

Controls the maximum number of order records returned in a single response. This allows clients to balance between response size and the number of API calls needed to retrieve all data.

The value must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. If omitted, defaults to 20 items per page. Note that the actual number of records returned may be less than this limit on the final page of results or when the total matching records are fewer than the limit.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter for maximum number of records per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100. Defaults to 20 if omitted. Used with page to implement offset-based pagination. Actual returned count may be less on the final page.

sort.description:
Field to sort results by.

Specifies which order attribute to use for sorting the result list. Three sort fields are available:

- created_at: Sort by order creation timestamp (default)
- code: Sort by human-readable order code alphabetically
- total_price: Sort by order total monetary value

Combine with the direction parameter to control ascending or descending order.
sort.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter specifying the field to sort results by. Allowed values: 'created_at' (order creation timestamp), 'code' (order code string), 'total_price' (order total amount). Defaults to 'created_at' if omitted. Used with direction parameter.

direction.description:
Sort direction.

Controls the order in which results are returned when sorting is applied. Two directions are available:

- asc: Ascending order (A to Z, lowest to highest, oldest to newest)
- desc: Descending order (Z to A, highest to lowest, newest to oldest)

The default direction is 'desc', which means orders are sorted with the most recently created orders appearing first. This is typically the most useful default for order history views.
direction.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter specifying sort direction. Allowed values: 'asc' (ascending), 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc' if omitted. Used with sort parameter. Default sort is created_at DESC (newest orders first).

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for filtering and paginating order lists.

This type defines the search criteria and pagination options for retrieving orders. All properties are optional, allowing flexible queries from simple pagination to complex filtered searches.

Use search to find orders by order code, status to filter by order status, and created_at_gte / created_at_lte for date range filtering. Pagination is controlled by page and limit, with sorting via sort and direction. The member_id and seller_id filters are primarily used in administrative endpoints for cross-user order queries.
IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for order list filtering and pagination. Maps to shopping_mall_orders table queries with optional JOINs. Supports: search (LIKE on code), status (exact match or array, computed from order_items), created_at_gte/lte (date range filtering on created_at), page/limit (offset-based pagination), sort (field name: created_at/code/total_price), direction (asc/desc). Admin endpoint additionally supports member_id filter (direct column match) and seller_id filter (requires JOIN to order_items). All fields optional - empty request returns all orders with default pagination (page=1, limit=20, sort=created_at, direction=desc). Exclude soft-deleted orders (deleted_at IS NULL) at query level.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Complete order entity representing a customer's purchase transaction with all order items, shipments, and metadata.

Orders are created when customers checkout their cart items. Each order has a unique code for customer reference, captures the total price at time of purchase, and contains one or more order items representing individual product variant purchases. Orders support soft deletion for data retention policies.

The {@link customer} field references the member who placed the order. The {@link orderItems} array contains all purchased items with their product snapshots preserving the state at purchase time. The {@link shipments} array contains tracking information for packages sent by sellers. Order-level status is derived from constituent order item statuses.
IShoppingMallOrder.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_orders: id, code, total_price, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at. Relations: customer via JOIN to shopping_mall_members (BELONGS-TO), orderItems via 1:N to shopping_mall_order_items (HAS-MANY), shipments via 1:N to shopping_mall_shipments (HAS-MANY). Order items include snapshot data from shopping_mall_order_item_snapshots and shopping_mall_order_item_snapshot_options. Member authorization: members can only access their own orders (member_id match), admins can access all orders.

search.description:
Full-text search query matching against product name and description fields.

When provided, filters products by searching for the query text in both the product name and description columns. Uses PostgreSQL trigram indexing for efficient fuzzy matching.

The search is case-insensitive and supports partial matching. For example, searching for 'phone' will match products with 'Smartphone' in the name or 'phone case' in the description. When combined with sort='relevance', results are ordered by text match score.

When provided, executes LIKE '%query%' or text search operators. Results ranked by relevance score when sort='relevance'. Empty or whitespace-only values are ignored. Special characters are escaped to prevent SQL injection.

categoryId.description:
Filter products by category UUID. May include products from subcategories.

Restricts results to products belonging to the specified category. When the category has subcategories, products from child categories are typically included in the results to provide comprehensive browsing.

The category ID must be a valid UUID format. If the category doesn't exist or has been deleted, the endpoint returns a 404 error. This filter is commonly combined with other filters like price range or search queries.
categoryId.x-autobe-specification: Category filter parameter. Maps to shopping_mall_products.shopping_mall_category_id column for exact match filtering. When provided, validates the UUID format and checks category existence. Optionally includes products from subcategories by recursively querying shopping_mall_categories.children relation. Returns 404 if category ID doesn't exist or refers to a deleted category.

minPrice.description:
Minimum base price filter (inclusive). Products with base_price >= minPrice are included.

Filters the product catalog to show only products priced at or above the specified minimum value. The price is compared against the product's base_price field, which represents the standard price before any variant-specific adjustments.

Must be a non-negative number. When combined with maxPrice, defines a price range. If minPrice exceeds maxPrice, the request returns a validation error. Omitting this parameter removes the lower price bound.
minPrice.x-autobe-specification: Minimum price filter parameter. Maps to shopping_mall_products.base_price column with >= comparison. Must be a non-negative number. If minPrice > maxPrice when both are provided, returns validation error. Null or omitted means no minimum price constraint. Implemented as WHERE base_price >= minPrice in SQL query.

maxPrice.description:
Maximum base price filter (inclusive). Products with base_price <= maxPrice are included.

Filters the product catalog to show only products priced at or below the specified maximum value. The price is compared against the product's base_price field, which represents the standard price before any variant-specific adjustments.

Must be a non-negative number. When combined with minPrice, defines a price range. If maxPrice is less than minPrice, the request returns a validation error. Omitting this parameter removes the upper price bound.

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and listing products with pagination, filtering, and sorting capabilities.

This DTO defines the query criteria for product catalog browsing. All fields are optional and can be combined to refine search results. The parameters support full-text search, category filtering, price range constraints, stock availability filtering, and flexible sorting options.

Search and Filtering: The search field performs full-text matching against product names and descriptions. Category filtering by UUID optionally includes products from subcategories. Price range filters constrain results to products within the specified minimum and maximum base price. The inStock flag restricts results to products with at least one variant having positive inventory.

Pagination: Results are paginated using page number (1-indexed) and limit (items per page, maximum 100). Default page is 1, default limit is typically 20.

Sorting: The sort field determines the ordering criterion with options for relevance (text search score), price ascending/descending, newest (creation date), and name alphabetically. The order parameter provides explicit direction when the sort field doesn't include it.

Pagination uses page (1-indexed offset) and limit (max 100) for offset-based pagination. Sorting applies ORDER BY based on sort field (relevance uses text search score, price_asc/desc uses base_price, newest uses created_at DESC, name_asc uses name) with order parameter providing explicit direction when sort field doesn't include it. All filters are optional and combinable. Excludes soft-deleted products (deleted_at IS NULL) and products from suspended sellers (JOIN shopping_mall_sellers WHERE approval_status = 'approved').

IShoppingMallShipment.description:
Complete shipment details including carrier information, tracking number, shipping and delivery timestamps, and all order items contained in the shipment.

Shipments represent physical packages sent by sellers containing one or more order items. Different sellers always ship separately, creating different shipments. When a shipment is created, all order items in it transition to "shipped" status. Customers confirm delivery per shipment, which transitions all items to "delivered" status. If not confirmed, items auto-transition to "delivered" after 14 days from shipping.

The {@link order} reference links to the parent order containing this shipment. The {@link seller} reference identifies which seller created and is responsible for the shipment. The {@link orderItems} array contains all individual purchased items grouped in this physical package.

IShoppingMallPostPurchaseCancellationReq.description:
Complete post-purchase cancellation request record with customer reason, workflow status, seller response, and related entities.

This DTO represents a customer's request to cancel an individual order item before shipment. The cancellation request includes the customer's reason for cancellation, the current workflow status (pending, approved, or rejected), and optionally the seller's response reason if the request was rejected.

The {@link member} field references the customer who requested the cancellation. The {@link orderItem} field identifies the specific purchased item being cancelled. The {@link seller} field references the seller responsible for reviewing and responding to the request. The {@link snapshots} array contains the complete audit trail of status changes throughout the request lifecycle.

The {@link status} field tracks the workflow state: 'pending' awaiting seller review, 'approved' when the seller accepts the cancellation, or 'rejected' when the seller declines. When rejected, the {@link seller_response_reason} provides the seller's explanation.

IShoppingMallMember.IJoin.description:
Registration credentials for creating a new customer member account.

This DTO is used as the request body for the customer registration endpoint (POST /shoppingMall/auth/member/join). The email address must be unique across all existing member accounts on the platform. The password is provided in plain text and will be securely hashed using bcrypt before storage in the database.

Session context fields (href, referrer, and optionally ip) capture the client context where the registration occurred. These fields are used for audit trail purposes and are stored in the shopping_mall_member_sessions table upon successful registration, not in the shopping_mall_members table itself.
