id.description:
Unique identifier for the member account.

This is the primary key of the member record, generated as a UUID v4 upon registration. Used to reference the member in all related operations including orders, reviews, and administrative oversight.

email.description:
Member email address used for authentication and communication.

This field serves as the primary login credential alongside password. Must be unique across all member accounts. Used for password reset emails, order confirmations, and platform notifications.

status.description:
Account status controlling access permissions.

Three states: 'active' (normal operation), 'banned' (administrator action preventing login), 'deleted' (soft delete preserving order history). Banned members cannot log in but their data remains for order/seller records. Deleted members have requested account deletion - profile is removed but orders and reviews are preserved as required by business rules.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the member account was created.

Records when the customer registered on the platform. Used for account age calculations, sorting member lists by registration date, and audit purposes.

customerProfile.description:
The customer profile associated with this member account.

Contains the member's display name and phone number for user-facing contexts. This relation is 1:1 with the shopping_mall_customer_profiles table. May be null if the member has not completed their profile setup or if the profile has been deleted.

IShoppingMallMember.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a customer member account for list views and reference contexts.

This DTO provides essential member account information used throughout the platform for identifying customers in administrative views, order history, cancellation/refund requests, and review authorship. The account status indicates whether the member is active, banned by administrators, or has requested account deletion.

The customerProfile field contains the member's display name and phone number when available. This relation may be null if the member has not completed their profile setup. The email field serves as the primary account identifier and login credential.

Timestamps track the account lifecycle: created_at records when the member registered on the platform.
IShoppingMallMember.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_members table: id (UUID), email (string), status (enum: active|banned|deleted), created_at (DateTime). Relation: customerProfile via JOIN on 1:1 relationship to shopping_mall_customer_profiles (returns IShoppingMallCustomerProfile.ISummary, nullable as not all members may have completed profile setup). Exclude: password_hash (security), updated_at (not needed for summary), deleted_at (system field), HAS-MANY relations (sessions, orders, reviews, wishlistItems, cart, cancellationRequests, refundRequests, postPurchaseCancellationRequests, postPurchaseRefundRequests - accessed via dedicated endpoints).

id.description:
Unique identifier for the cancellation request snapshot.

This is the primary key of the snapshot record, generated as a UUID v4 when the snapshot is created. Used to uniquely identify this specific state capture in the audit trail.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots.id. UUID v4 format generated when snapshot is created.

status.description:
The cancellation request status at the time this snapshot was created.

Valid values include: 'pending' (awaiting seller response), 'approved' (seller approved the cancellation), 'rejected' (seller rejected the cancellation). This field captures the exact status at the snapshot moment, enabling historical tracking of status transitions even if the current request status changes.
status.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots.status. Values: 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

reason.description:
The customer's reason for requesting cancellation at the time of this snapshot.

This text field preserves the exact reason provided by the customer when they submitted the cancellation request. The reason is captured once during initial request creation and remains unchanged in all subsequent snapshots, providing context for dispute resolution.
reason.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots.reason. Free text provided by customer.

seller_response.description:
The seller's response message when approving or rejecting the cancellation request.

This field is populated only when the seller takes action on the request. It may contain approval confirmation, rejection explanation, or additional notes from the seller. Null for the initial snapshot created when the customer first submits the request before any seller response.
seller_response.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots.seller_response. Nullable - null for initial snapshot, string when seller responds.

created_at.description:
The timestamp when this snapshot record was created.

Records the exact moment when the state change occurred and this snapshot was captured. Enables chronological ordering of snapshots to reconstruct the complete history of the cancellation request. Used for audit trail verification and dispute resolution timelines.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots.created_at. ISO 8601 date-time format with timezone.

cancellationRequest.description:
The parent cancellation request this snapshot belongs to.

References the cancellation request that this snapshot captures the state of. Each cancellation request can have multiple snapshots representing its state at different points in time. This relation enables navigation from a snapshot back to the current request state.
cancellationRequest.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via JOIN on shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_id to shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_requests. Returns IShoppingMallPostPurchaseCancellationRequest.ISummary.

seller.description:
The seller who responded to this cancellation request snapshot.

This field is populated when the seller takes action on the cancellation request (approve or reject). For the initial snapshot created when the customer submits the request, this field is null as no seller response exists yet. Links to the seller account for identity verification and accountability.
seller.x-autobe-specification: Relation mapping via LEFT JOIN on shopping_mall_seller_id to shopping_mall_sellers. Returns IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary or null for initial snapshot before seller response.

IShoppingMallPostPurchaseCancellationReq.description:
Immutable audit snapshot capturing the complete state of a post-purchase cancellation request at a specific point in time.

This snapshot record preserves the exact state of a cancellation request when significant events occur: when the customer initially submits the request, and when the seller responds by approving or rejecting it. Each snapshot includes the status at that moment, the customer's cancellation reason, and optionally the seller's response message if the seller took action.

The cancellationRequest field references the parent cancellation request this snapshot belongs to. The seller field references the seller who responded to the request, and is null for the initial snapshot created when the customer first submits the request (before any seller response). The status field captures the workflow state at the snapshot moment: 'pending' awaiting seller review, 'approved' when the seller accepts the cancellation, or 'rejected' when the seller declines. The reason field preserves the customer's original cancellation reason. The seller_response field contains the seller's response message when they approve or reject the request, and is null for the initial snapshot.

Snapshots are created automatically by the system and cannot be modified or deleted, ensuring a complete audit trail for dispute resolution and compliance purposes.
IShoppingMallPostPurchaseCancellationReq.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_snapshots table. Columns: id (UUID), status (string), reason (string), seller_response (string, nullable), created_at (DateTime). Relations: cancellationRequest via JOIN on shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_request_id to shopping_mall_post_purchase_cancellation_requests (returns IShoppingMallPostPurchaseCancellationRequest.ISummary), seller via LEFT JOIN on shopping_mall_seller_id to shopping_mall_sellers (returns IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary, nullable for initial snapshot before seller response). This is an immutable audit snapshot - records are created automatically by the system when cancellation request status changes or seller responds. No Create/Update operations - snapshots are system-generated.

imageId.description:
Unique identifier of the product image to reorder.

References the image record in the product gallery. Must belong to the product specified in the API endpoint path. The image will be assigned the new display order position specified in the displayOrder field.
imageId.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_product_images.id. UUID format. Service validates the image exists and belongs to the product specified in the endpoint path.

displayOrder.description:
New display order position for the image in the gallery sequence.

Determines where the image appears in the product gallery. Lower values appear first, with 0 being the main thumbnail shown in product listings and search results. When submitting a reorder request, all display order values across the array must form a consecutive sequence starting from 0 with no gaps or duplicates.
displayOrder.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_product_images.display_order. Integer >= 0. Service validates all displayOrder values across the reorder array form a consecutive sequence starting from 0 with no duplicates.

IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderItem.description:
Individual image reorder operation specifying which image to reposition and its new gallery position.

Each reorder item contains the image's unique identifier and the new display order position it should occupy. The display order determines the sequence in which images appear in the product gallery, with position 0 being the main thumbnail shown in product listings and search results.

This DTO is used as an array element within IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderRequest. When submitting a reorder request, all display order values across the array must form a consecutive sequence starting from 0 with no gaps or duplicates.
IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderItem.x-autobe-specification: Request DTO for reordering product images in the gallery. Used as array element in IShoppingMallProductImage.IReorderRequest. Each item specifies one image's new position. Service validates: (1) imageId exists in shopping_mall_product_images and belongs to the product in the endpoint path, (2) seller owns the product, (3) all displayOrder values across the array form a consecutive sequence starting from 0 with no gaps or duplicates. Maps imageId to shopping_mall_product_images.id and displayOrder to shopping_mall_product_images.display_order.

id.description:
Unique identifier for the seller profile.

Auto-generated UUID assigned when the seller's approval request is approved and the profile is created. Used to reference the profile in API operations and to link profile snapshots to their source.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.id. UUID format generated when seller approval request is approved.

seller.description:

seller.x-autobe-specification: JOIN from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.seller_id to shopping_mall_sellers.id. Returns IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary with email and approval status.

shop_name.description:
The seller's shop or store name displayed to customers.

This is the public-facing name of the seller's business on the platform. Appears on the seller's storefront, in order confirmations, and in search results. Sellers can edit this field through their profile management interface.
shop_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.shop_name. Displayed on storefront and order confirmations.

shop_description.description:
A description of the seller's shop and business.

Provides customers with information about the seller's business, products, values, and policies. Displayed on the seller's storefront page. Sellers can edit this field to update their shop presentation.
shop_description.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.shop_description. Provides business information to customers.

logo_image_url.description:
URL to the seller's shop logo image.

The logo is displayed on the seller's storefront and in order confirmations. This field is nullable to allow sellers to create profiles without immediately uploading a logo. When present, the URL points to the stored image file.
logo_image_url.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.logo_image_url. Nullable - null when no logo uploaded. URI format for image URL.

created_at.description:
Timestamp when the seller profile was created.

Automatically set when the seller's approval request is approved and the profile is initialized. Used to track when the seller joined the platform and to order profiles chronologically in list views.
created_at.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from shopping_mall_seller_profiles.created_at. Set when profile is initialized upon seller approval. Date-time format in UTC.

Seller profiles contain the shop name, description, and logo image that customers see when browsing the seller's storefront. This summary type includes essential display fields optimized for list views and public-facing contexts.

Customer's display name shown throughout the platform.
